About This Auction

This property offers outstanding recreational opportunities with abundant wildlife sign and exceptional habitat created by previous select logging has produced thick bedding cover and abundant deer browse. The elevation changes and wet-weather creek create natural travel corridors that funnel wildlife movement, while an established trail system provides easy access to stand locations and access throughout the property.  With ag fields boarding the property an abundant annual food source is available for wildlife . The mixed hardwood timber has aboundant amount of white oak and walnut trees, offering both food for wildlife and future timber income. Ridge tops with great access provide excellent locations for a future home, cabin, or food plot locations. With good road frontage along the east side, utilities available at the road, and convenient access to more than 8,000 acres of public land just 8 miles away this tract provides endless opportunities. If you're interested in checking out this property the open house will be on August 22nd. This property is up for auction via an online platform. It will be offere in 3 tracts.  Tract 1 - 36.54 acres to the north Tract 2 - 38.08 acres to the south Tract 3 - The whole 74.62 acres Bidding opens September 4th and closes September 8th. Visit our website or downlaod our app to register and bid.
